suggestions: As an Agency user, I want to save an in-progress FABS submission as a draft, so that I can complete and submit it later without re-entering data.
As a FABS user, I want to receive email notifications when my submission status changes, so that I can take timely action on errors or approvals.
As an Agency user, I want to search and filter submission history by date, status, or file name, so that I can quickly locate specific submissions.
As a FABS user, I want validation errors to show the row number and field name in the UI, so that I can locate and fix data issues faster.
As an Agency user, I want to submit a file for validation without triggering publication, so that I can confirm data quality before deciding to publish.
As a Developer, I want an API endpoint that returns the current submission status, so that agency systems can programmatically monitor submissions.
As a FABS user, I want to download validation error reports in a structured format such as CSV, so that I can share and analyze errors offline.
As a Broker user, I want a searchable guide explaining each validation rule and error code, so that I can correct submission errors without contacting support.
As an Agency user, I want to submit supplemental files for the same reporting period without replacing or duplicating the original data, so that I can provide corrections or additional records.
As a Developer, I want each published record to include its source submission and load batch identifier, so that I can trace data lineage and resolve disputes.
As an Owner, I want to configure FABS submission start and end dates per agency, so that agencies are only allowed to submit during their designated periods.
As a Developer, I want versioned database migration scripts for FABS schema and validation rule changes, so that deployments are repeatable across environments.
As an Agency user, I want a sandbox environment that mirrors production validation rules, so that I can practice submissions before the real deadline.
As a FABS user, I want to copy a previous submission as the starting point for a new submission, so that I can make small updates without creating a file from scratch.
As an Agency user, I want to enter a small number of FABS records through a web form, so that I don't need to create and upload a file for minor submissions.
As a UI designer, I want to conduct an accessibility review of FABS pages against Section 508 standards, so that all users can access the application.
As a Developer, I want automated regression tests for FABS validation rules, so that rule updates do not unexpectedly break accepted submissions.
As a broker team member, I want a dashboard showing validation error frequency by rule and agency, so that I can prioritize rule improvements and user outreach.
As an Agency user, I want the submission dashboard to display the remaining time until the submission deadline, so that I can prioritize submission work.
As an Agency user, I want to set a default agency context in my profile, so that I don't need to select the same agency repeatedly.
As an Owner, I want to assign different Broker roles to users within my agency, so that only authorized users can submit or publish data.
As an Agency user, I want a second-person approval step before a submission is published, so that data errors are caught before public release.
As an Owner, I want a complete audit trail of who published, corrected, or deleted records and when, so that I can comply with federal records requirements.
As a Data user, I want an API to retrieve published FABS data by date range, so that I can automate data consumption incrementally.
As a Website user, I want to search published financial assistance data by recipient, agency, or CFDA number, so that I can find relevant awards more easily.
As a FABS user, I want to preview derived field values before publishing, so that I can verify derivations match my expectations.
As a FABS user, I want the system to clearly report non-UTF-8 encoding errors in my file, so that I can fix special characters before submission.
As a Developer, I want circuit breakers on external SAM and FPDS calls, so that Broker remains responsive when dependent systems are slow or unavailable.
As an Owner, I want a status page indicating the health of external data sources such as SAM and FPDS, so that I can communicate known outages to users.
As an Agency user, I want to log in to Broker using my SAM account credentials, so that I don't need to maintain a separate Broker password.
As a Developer, I want all Broker application traffic to be served over HTTPS, so that submission data is encrypted in transit.
As a FABS user, I want the submission dashboard to remember my filters and sort order between sessions, so that I can return to my preferred view.
As an agency user, I want the FABS validation rules to accept a blank AwardingAgencyCode when FundingAgencyCode is provided, so that valid records are not rejected.
As a Developer, I want feature flags to enable or disable FABS features per environment, so that I can safely roll out changes and revert if needed.
As a broker team member, I want old validation reports to be automatically archived after a retention period, so that storage and performance remain manageable.
As a Data user, I want a data dictionary that defines each FABS field and derived element, so that I can understand the published data.
As an Agency user, I want to see what validation rules changed in each release, so that I can update my submission file accordingly.
As an Agency user, I want to upload large FABS files without hitting a restrictive size limit, so that I can submit all my agency's records in one file.

As a Data Consuming User, I want to see textual descriptions that accompany embedded visualisations, So that I can more easily understand what I am viewing.
As a Data Consuming User, I want to be able to share a view state as a URL to social networks, So that I can share data that I have found with others.
As a Data Consuming User, I want to be able to download an image ofa particular view state, So that I can use it offline.
As a Data Consuming User, I want to have consistent use of colour on map visualisations, So that I can better understand the visual logic of the map view.
As an API User, I want to have a flexible API using HASC codes for countries, regions and cities, So that I can visualise budget data on maps.
As an API User, I want to be able to get a relative percentage of a measure to the total of the dataset it comes from, So that I can build alternative displays of the data.
As a Data Publishing User, I want to have my dataset update automatically as the source file/files changes, So that OpenSpending always shows current data.
As an OpenSpending Community Member, I want to have an app where I can find examples of use of fiscal data visualisations, So that I can find guidance in creating my own with Open Spending.

suggestions: As a Data Publishing User, I want to edit the metadata (title, description, tags, license) of a dataset I have published, so that I can keep its discoverability and usage terms accurate.

As a Data Publishing User, I want to validate my data against the Fiscal Data Package model during import, so that I can correct structural errors before building visualisations.
As a Data Publishing User, I want to grant view access to a Hidden dataset to specific users or API tokens, so that I can collaborate with reviewers before publishing.
As a Data Publishing User, I want to duplicate an existing dataset as a starting point, so that I can create a similar dataset without rebuilding the model and mappings.
As a Data Publishing User, I want to schedule automatic re-imports from a Google Spreadsheet source, so that my dataset stays up to date without manual updates.
As a Platform Administrator, I want to manage user accounts and publishing privileges, so that I can grant or revoke access to the publishing tools.
As a Platform Administrator, I want to view an audit log of administrative actions on datasets, so that I can track who hid or deleted public content and when.
As a Platform Administrator, I want to feature selected datasets on the OpenSpending homepage, so that high-quality or timely datasets are easier for users to discover.
As a Data Consuming User, I want to filter and drill down into a dataset by dimensions before visualising, so that I can explore meaningful subsets of the data without using the API.
As a Data Consuming User, I want to download the original source file of a public dataset, so that I can analyse the full dataset in my own tools.
As a Data Consuming User, I want to view the data behind a visualisation as a sortable table, so that I can inspect the exact values used in charts and maps.
As a Data Consuming User, I want to compare measures from two or more datasets in a single visualisation, so that I can analyse cross-dataset trends without switching contexts.
As a Data Consuming User, I want to embed an OpenSpending visualisation in an external website, so that I can share the interactive view in my own content.
As an API User, I want to paginate and sort query results, so that I can work with large result sets efficiently.
As an API User, I want to retrieve the model or schema for a dataset, so that I can build valid cube queries against its dimensions and measures.
As an API User, I want to filter cube queries by arbitrary dimension values, so that I can request only the data slices relevant to my application.
As an API User, I want to use historical currency conversion rates when normalising monetary measures, so that comparisons are accurate for earlier fiscal years.
As an API User, I want to receive structured error messages and validation feedback from the API, so that I can debug invalid queries quickly.
As a Developer, I want official API documentation with interactive query examples, so that I can integrate OpenSpending more quickly.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to automatically generate a Table Schema from my tabular data, so that I can describe fields without writing descriptors by hand.
details.reason: Type information and metadata stories cover manual additions, but not schema generation.

details.story: As a Researcher, I want to export a Data Package to an Excel file, so that I can share data with colleagues who use spreadsheets.
details.reason: Existing story covers Excel-to-Data Package but not the reverse direction.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to provide a filterable and sortable table view of my data, so that users can explore it before downloading.
details.reason: Existing preview stories cover visualization and summary, but not interactive tabular exploration.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to publish Data Packages with restricted access, so that I can share sensitive or embargoed data with selected users.
details.reason: Publishing stories assume public data and do not cover access control.

details.story: As a Researcher, I want to verify that a downloaded Data Package matches its published checksum, so that I can trust that the data has not been altered.
details.reason: Validation stories cover structure but not integrity or checksum verification.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to see differences between two versions of a Data Package, so that I can understand what changed after an update.
details.reason: Versioning and update validation imply change tracking but no diff story exists.

details.story: As a DeveloperPublisher, I want a GitHub Action that validates my Data Package on every commit, so that I can catch errors without running validation manually.
details.reason: Existing validation stories include CLI and online service but not a ready-made CI action.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to expose schema.org Dataset metadata from my Data Package, so that my dataset is more discoverable by search engines.
details.reason: Existing publishing and metadata stories cover CKAN and funding, but not structured web metadata.

details.story: As a Researcher, I want to create a Data Package from a CSV file, so that I can package plain tabular data with metadata.
details.reason: Existing import stories cover Excel and EML, but plain CSV is the most common tabular format and is not explicitly covered.

details.reason: Publishing a public dataset normally requires declaring its usage terms.

details.reason: Consumers need a feedback channel for broken or inappropriate data packages.

details.story: As a Publisher, I want to permanently delete a data package, so that it is completely removed from the registry and no longer consumes storage.
details.reason: Unpublish and restore stories mention deletion, but permanent removal is not explicitly covered.

details.story: As a user, I want to sort search results by relevance, date, or file type, so that I can quickly locate the most relevant items.
details.reason: Search result filtering and file type search are covered but sorting is not.

details.story: As a user, I want to add comments to a log book page, so that I can discuss experiments with colleagues.
details.reason: Logbook pages support creation and sharing but not discussion comments.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to export a log book page or section to PDF, so that I can share it outside Neurohub or print it.
details.reason: Logbook content is created in HTML but no export or print capability is specified.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to create a log book page from a predefined template, so that experiments follow a consistent structure.
details.reason: Metadata templates exist, but logbook page templates are not described.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to link related log book pages to each other, so that I can navigate between connected experiments.
details.reason: Experimental runs can be linked but logbook pages themselves lack cross-links.

details.story: As a user, I want to request a booking for shared equipment, so that I can reserve it for a specific date and time.
details.reason: Events and equipment bookings can be viewed but booking requests are missing.

details.story: As a lab member, I want to request consumables from the inventory, so that stock levels are tracked and replenished.
details.reason: Equipment and consumables inventory is available but request/replenishment workflow is missing.

details.story: As a lab administrator, I want to receive alerts when inventory items are low, so that I can reorder supplies in time.
details.reason: Inventory visibility exists but no low-stock alerting is specified.

details.story: As a user, I want to create and edit events in the shared group calendar, so that others can see my schedule.
details.reason: Shared calendars are viewable but event creation is not covered.

details.story: As a user, I want to synchronize the shared group calendar with my personal calendar client, so that I can view all events in one place.
details.reason: Calendar viewing via web and mobile is covered, but external sync is not.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to create and edit workflows within Neurohub, so that I can reuse analysis steps.
details.reason: Workflow execution is recorded, but workflow authoring is not specified.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to share workflows with colleagues, so that they can reuse my analysis protocols.
details.reason: Workflow execution is logged, but sharing workflows is not described.

details.story: As a user, I want to monitor running workflow executions in real time, so that I know when they are complete.
details.reason: Workflow history is recorded but live execution status is missing.

details.story: As a system administrator, I want to schedule automatic backups of Neurohub data, so that data can be restored after a failure.
details.reason: Manual deletion recovery and installation exist, but system-level backup is not specified.

details.story: As a system administrator, I want to set storage quotas per user or group, so that disk usage is controlled.
details.reason: Large file uploads and remote data are supported but quota management is missing.

details.story: As a user, I want Neurohub to verify file integrity upon upload and download using checksums, so that I can be confident files are not corrupted.
details.reason: Large and bulk uploads exist but integrity verification is not covered.

details.story: As a user, I want to pause and resume large file uploads, so that network interruptions do not force me to restart an upload.
details.reason: Large file upload is supported but resumable upload is not specified.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to import files from external cloud storage or data repositories, so that I can consolidate data in Neurohub.
details.reason: Remote access and bulk upload exist but external source import is missing.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to convert files between common formats, so that I can use them with different analysis tools.
details.reason: Specific video encoding is mentioned, but general file conversion is not covered.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to preview data files such as images and spreadsheets in the web interface, so that I can inspect them without downloading.
details.reason: Files can be downloaded and searched but not previewed in-place.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to flag data as good or bad in batches, so that I can efficiently curate large datasets.
details.reason: Individual good/bad marking is covered, but batch quality control is not.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to set an embargo date before shared data becomes visible to others, so that I can protect unpublished work.
details.reason: Privacy and sharing restrictions exist but temporal embargo is missing.

details.story: As a user, I want to share a file or logbook entry via a temporary access link, so that external collaborators can view it without a full account.
details.reason: Sharing with individuals and groups exists but temporary external links are not specified.

details.story: As a user, I want to control what events trigger email or in-app notifications, so that I am not overwhelmed by updates.
details.reason: Various notifications exist but user notification preferences are not described.

details.story: As a user, I want to receive in-app notifications when colleagues share data or comment on my entries, so that I can respond promptly.
details.reason: Collaboration features exist but in-app activity notifications are missing.

details.story: As a user, I want to manage my profile and contact information, so that colleagues can identify me.
details.reason: User roles and group communication imply user profiles, which are not specified.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to generate API access tokens for programmatic access, so that I can integrate external tools with Neurohub.
details.reason: Workflows and external software integration are covered but API credentials are not.

details.story: As a lab administrator, I want to define custom metadata schemas for different file types, so that metadata entry is standardized.
details.reason: Metadata is attached per file type and restricted, but schema management is missing.

details.story: As a lab administrator, I want to manage the controlled vocabulary terms, so that tagging remains consistent across the group.
details.reason: Users must use a controlled vocabulary, but no management interface is specified.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to export protocols to standard formats and import external protocols, so that I can share protocols beyond Neurohub.
details.reason: Protocols are searchable and creatable but import/export is not covered.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to record when a protocol was followed and link it to the resulting data, so that experiments are reproducible.
details.reason: Protocol creation and data provenance are covered, but explicit protocol execution linkage is missing.
